concept: Auto Scaling: CPU target tracking for an elastic web tier
tests: Understanding how to scale EC2 behind an ALB with load automatically, without manual intervention.
expected: Auto Scaling group with a target tracking policy on average CPU — adds/removes instances on its own. Triggers: "scale automatically based on demand", "no manual intervention", "instances overwhelmed".
why_not: Cross-zone load balancing only evens out traffic; CloudFront caches but doesn't scale compute; vertical scaling has a ceiling and requires manual action.
